scripts.build: npm run link-imports && npm run esbuild && npm run tsc
scripts.build:clean: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.dev: npm run clean && npm run link-imports && npm run esbuild && concurrently --kill-others --prefix-colors=auto --names=typescript,meteor,esbuild 'npm run tsc:watch -- --preserveWatchOutput' 'npm run meteor' 'npm run esbuild:watch'
scripts.meteor: bash -c 'IP=$(ipconfig getifaddr en0 2>/dev/null || ipconfig getifaddr en1 2>/dev/null); echo "Binding to $IP:3000"; ROOT_URL=http://$IP:3000 DDP_DEFAULT_CONNECTION_URL=http://$IP:3000 meteor --no-lint --port 0.0.0.0:3000'
scripts._clean:windows: Get-ChildItem -r -i client | Where{$_.Name -Match '*.\.js*.'} | rm -r -fo && Get-ChildItem -r -i public | Where{$_.Name -Match '*.\.js*.'} | rm -r -fo
scripts.preinstall:
node -e "const cmd=process.env.npm_command;const isCi=cmd==='ci'||cmd==='rebuild';const isBypassFlag=process.env.npm_config_i_know_what_im_doing;if(!isCi&&process.argv.length<=2&&!isBypassFlag){console.error('

################################################
DO NOT use "npm install" on its own without a package name.
Only use "npm clean-install" for installing all project dependencies.
Always commit package-lock.json after updates!
Use "npm install --i-know-what-im-doing" to bypass this check.
################################################
');process.exit(1);}"
